existing.beforeBody: select bucket='trip-attachments' and (path ~ '^trips/[^/]+/attachments/actual_expense/[^/]+/receipts/' or app_private.receipts_activated() and (path ~ '^trips/[^/]+/attachments/actual_expense/' or exists(select 1 from public.attachments where target_type='actual_expense' and file_url=path)) or exists(select 1 from app_private.budget_receipt_intents where object_path=path) or exists(select 1 from app_private.budget_receipt_cleanup where object_path=path))
existing.afterBody: select bucket='trip-attachments' and (path ~ '^trips/[^/]+/attachments/actual_expense/[^/]+/receipts/' or (app_private.receipts_activated() or app_private.budget_receipt_legacy_frozen()) and (path ~ '^trips/[^/]+/attachments/actual_expense/' or exists(select 1 from public.attachments where target_type='actual_expense' and file_url=path)) or exists(select 1 from app_private.budget_receipt_intents where object_path=path) or exists(select 1 from app_private.budget_receipt_cleanup where object_path=path))
